status: Checked interval component under the candidate clock contract; no system clock adapter or HTTP engine adoption

contract.elapsed_reading: For t normalized reference units, between t-E and 2t+E, nondecreasing
contract.error: E bounds the entire elapsed measurement including sampling and quantization
contract.child_duration: floor(max(0, R-3*E)/2), anchored to child request start
contract.units: Unsigned 64-bit local nanoseconds; profiles and deadline additions are checked

implementation.identity: Distinct in-process reference-counted identity; retained starts keep it alive to prevent allocation reuse
implementation.clock_failure: Unavailable, out-of-range or backwards readings permanently retire the timeline
implementation.overflow: Profiles and absolute deadlines return errors; no wrapped grants
implementation.fresh_checks: Remaining-time, child issuance and drain-completion queries read the supplied clock
implementation.storage: Fixed-size interval bookkeeping and one shared identity allocation per timeline; retained caller records and the supplied clock need separate bounds

generated_bounds.clock_readings: Extremal slow and fast readings allowed by the model; independent origins and child/request delays

coverage: Replies consume the original root/child interval despite newer captured starts
Drain confirmation uses its full error margin
Zero duration and exact expiry allow no service
Restarts reject foreign starts, deadlines and drains
Unavailable, backwards and out-of-range readings cannot be revived
Invalid profiles, oversized child lifetimes and absolute overflow fail closed
Boundary deadlines at u64::MAX are representable and expire exactly
Fast successor drains exclude a slow old root; delayed slow children do not outlive fast parents
limitations: No qualification of physical clocks, suspend, VM migration or live-memory restoration
No selected L/E values or authenticated common-profile wire format
No root/placement controller, provider invocation binding, journal or transaction composition
A deadline alone is not authority; callers must establish ownership, current assignment, recovery and a consistent data view
Tests and arithmetic proof are not a mechanized Rust or complete protocol refinement
No serving performance or new cloud qualification; current HTTP read barriers remain

qualification.reason: Local validation is recorded; a subsequent complete Woodpecker run must qualify this new Rust component.
